linked_observations.observation: The repeat CSF result (178 cells/µL vs 183 cells/µL) is correctly used to shift diagnostic weight toward ongoing meningitis while preserving the orthostatic/PDPH considerations.

d5c.evidence_quote: Next: CSF culture and viral/TB PCR panel; consider repeat LP if opening pressure was not recorded.
d5c.reason: The interview made well-timed, targeted requests covering the prior admission (reason, treatment, imaging), current readmission features and reports (examination, MRI, repeat CSF), and the discriminating opening pressure. The infection-evidence gap was addressed only as a proposed next step in the written answer rather than as an actual interview request, and confirmation that an LP was performed was likewise deferred, slightly limiting timeliness.
